expected_safe_actions: Record daily mortality, breathing changes and the spread of skin, fin and gill lesions.
Recheck dissolved oxygen, ammonia, nitrite, pH and temperature if conditions change.
Minimise further handling and crowding stress.
Continue photographing external lesions and contact a fish-health laboratory for examination of suitable affected fish before disease-specific treatment.
expected_escalation: Seek prompt professional help because respiratory distress and skin or gill lesions are spreading and mortality is increasing.
expected_confirmation: Examine fresh skin, fin and gill samples and perform bacterial culture and laboratory identification while assessing water quality and possible coexisting disease.
